messages:
maria-finance: Quick alert 10, new price sheet ready. Found a small mapping gap that could leave a handful of reserved customers un-grandfathered if we flip the A/B tomorrow morning.
liam-billing: Details: three legacy SKU aliases not mapped to canonical SKUs. If unpatched, ~7 accounts impacted, monthly exposure ~ $9.2k.
ash-product: Can we patch before rollout?
olivia-eng: Yep. Small canonicalization table change. I can push to staging and do a prod canary within 30m.
sofia-legal: Drafted a short customer note in case credits are needed: no admission of error, offer applied credit, link to billing portal.
maria-finance: Preference is pre-rollout patch. If any slips through, manual credits ok up to $15k with CFO sign-off.
liam-billing: I'll run a reconciliation job after prod deploy and flag any mismatches.
olivia-eng: Staging deploy started. deploy-bot: release/sku-canonical-fix -> staging (build 4832).
maria-finance: Hold the flag flip until billing confirms zero mismatches.
liam-billing: Reconciliation run against latest export found 1 misclassified account. Estimated credit $1,120. Flagging and holding.
sofia-legal: Approve outbound credit note. Keep wording conservative.
olivia-eng: Promoting fix to prod now. deploy-bot: promoted release/sku-canonical-fix -> prod (build 4832). No anomalies in 5m smoke.
liam-billing: After prod promotion, re-ran reconciliation: zero remaining misclassifications.
maria-finance: CFO OK to proceed. Nash, you can flip the A/B split when ready.
ash-product: I'll flip the flag after a final quick metric check. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
